summary.text: Trojan whom Agamemnon stabbed upon the navel beneath his bossed shield as he leapt down from his car — Apollodorus names a Chersidamas among Priam's sons by other women, and a separate Chersidamas in the Electryon stemma.

story.text: After slaying Thoön and Eunomus, Agamemnon stabbed Chersidamas as he leapt down from his car, driving the spear upon the navel beneath the bossed shield; he fell in the dust and clutched the ground with his palm.
